svg.text: The private lane runs Tend on the owner's real accounts. Every box is one n8n workflow (numbered as in workflows/) or one service, and every arrow is labelled with what travels on it.
The classroom lane runs the same steps on fictional data (workflows 01 to 09, 21, 23 and 24); both lanes are drawn in Architecture.mmd in the repository.
